title: Hugging Face Transformers
description: State-of-the-art Machine Learning library for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX providing thousands of pretrained models for text, vision, and audio tasks.
features: Unified API for thousands of state-of-the-art pretrained transformer architectures
Seamless switching between PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX runtimes
Quantization support via bitsandbytes, AWQ, and GPTQ for low-memory execution
Automated pipeline abstraction for NLP, Computer Vision, and Speech tasks
Direct hub integration for downloading weights, tokenizers, and datasets
pros: The undisputed foundational cornerstone of modern open-source AI and ML research
Enormous active global community and unmatched model ecosystem
Clear abstraction layers for fine-tuning, training, and inference
cons: Python-centric ecosystem requires Python runtime or ONNX export for JS runtime usage
Heavy library footprint with deep dependency graphs
targetAudience: Machine learning engineers, AI researchers, and data scientists fine-tuning and serving neural networks.
